segments: After every player completes all three Trials, charge the Zombie Shield with the challenge lightning, electrify the zipline setup, and drop onto the hidden dock for the third cog.
The dangerous part is the drop timing. Missing the hidden dock can down or kill you, so clear the area and set the attempt up before riding.
Once every player has completed all three of their Trials, use the challenge lightning/electric reward to charge the Zombie Shield for this step.
Go to the Lab A / Docks zipline and use the electrified-shield setup on the zipline control panel.
Ride from the Docks side toward Lab A and trigger the drop when you are over the hidden pier.
Solo: use the electrified setup, ride the zipline, then melee at the correct point to release onto the dock.
Co-op: one player rides while another activates/electrifies the panel at the correct moment to drop the rider.
Collect the cog from the hidden dock and return to the main map with the final elevator component.
